QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] Visitors from Beyond the Stars
QuestInfo.0: WAT. An entire mini-planet just broke up in Maple World's atmosphere. Today just got interesting.
QuestInfo.1: An undersized planet collides with the magical shield protecting Maple World's atmosphere, and its fragments rain down upon the land. You then meet #b#p9400425##k, an alien whose species, the Ryuul wander the stars in search of their origin, and in pursuit of power to utilize for the #bAbsolute Good#k.\r\n\r\n#b#p9400425##k explains her people's arrival on Maple World, and #bsuggests that you join them in their efforts to harness the powers of the rare ores found within the remnants of the planet Eluna.
